findings.title: A Remnant card's By select keeps a replacement the GM cancelled when the card redraws under the question
findings.surface: A GM's card of a Remnant
findings.control: By (Left by) select and its 'Who left this Remnant' question
findings.what_happens: Changing the select on a trace that already names an author opens the question and waits on it (remnant-ring.mjs:337). The card is a live region that watches every item and token hook and the trace ledger (255), and focus is now in the question, so any such event redraws the card 120 ms later. The redraw reads the select as a field the GM changed, and puts the unsaved pick onto the new select (live.mjs:481, 548), which is wired afresh (256). Cancel then writes the old author back onto the old select, which is no longer in the window (343). The card shows the new author, the ledger holds the old one, and no change event is left to save or to put back.
findings.failure_scenario: During an investigation a GM picks another student in By, a player's token moves while 'Who left this Remnant' is open, the GM presses Cancel: the card goes on showing the student who was never saved, while Observe's Follow My Traces and Tamper read the old one.
findings.expected: remnant-ring.mjs:328-329: 'a closed or refused question puts the select back'.
findings.refutation_tried: Looked for something that holds the region while the question is open: isEditing (live.mjs:375-382) asks for focus inside the region, which the question took; the press hold ends at the pointer's release (RELEASES). Checked that the select is carried: it has no name, key or id, so it is matched by its place in the region (keyFor, live.mjs:414-427), and the card's shape does not change between the two draws. Checked a later redraw: the new select is still dirty against the ledger's default, so each redraw carries the pick again. With no watched event during the question the Cancel works as written. Not run.
findings.probe: On the GM's page: open the sheet of a Remnant token whose row names an author (token.actor.sheet.render(true)); set select[data-drpg-author] to another student and dispatch 'change'; while the question stands call Hooks.callAll('updateToken', anyTokenDocument, {}) and wait 150 ms; press Cancel; compare document.querySelector('.drpg-remnant-card select[data-drpg-author]').value with remnantData(token).sourceActor.

findings.title: On a reshape card whose Remnant is gone, Approve can never settle the card and whispers the roller again at every press
findings.surface: The reshape card ('A Remnant made to read differently')
findings.what_happens: Approve asks the primary to rule (askReshapeRuling -> ruleReshape -> applyReshapeRuling). When the trace's token is gone the ruling claims nothing, warns the pressing GM 'That Remnant is gone, so there is nothing to reshape. The player is told.', whispers the roller 'The Remnant you were working on is already gone. The effort still cost you.' and answers null. The card's handler settles only on true or false, so the card keeps both buttons, enabled, and each further Approve sends the roller the same whisper again. The one press that closes the card is Refuse, whose whisper then says the Remnant 'reads as before', of a Remnant that no longer exists.
findings.failure_scenario: A chapter's sweep or another clean-up removes the trace while a reshape waits; a GM presses Approve twice to clear the card: the roller reads 'already gone' twice, the card still stands with both buttons, and Refuse closes it with 'the Remnant reads as before'.
findings.expected: A ruling that can no longer be made ends its card, as an attempt a Reroll replaced does (messenger-app.mjs:1080-1083: 'false is a ruling that went through ... and the card says so').
findings.refutation_tried: Checked that nothing marks the row ruled on this road: claimRuling is skipped when the trace is gone (cleanup-reshape.mjs:611), so a later press is not answered 'already ruled'. Checked that the card does not settle elsewhere: wireCallActions settles only on outcome.settled (messenger-app.mjs:771-774) and releases the buttons otherwise (783). The Reinforced refusal beside it (626-629) rightly leaves the card open, since a GM can lift it. The domain reader's hints name the same press (domain-case-b-traces, dead_controls).
findings.probe: In the harness: a successful Tamper reshape by a player (cleanup.attemptCleanup, mode 'transform'), then removeRemnant(token) on the GM, then press [data-drpg-call=approveReshape] on the card twice: count the roller's 'already gone' whispers and read that the card's settled flag is unset; then press [data-drpg-call=declineReshape] and read the roller's line.

not_established: Nothing was pressed or run: every row is a source reading at b5a29e73 (the audit branch adds papers and two probes only). The tests and scenarios named were found by git grep of the action or function name in scripts/tests-tier*.mjs and audit/harness/scenarios; their results are the base run's, not read here.

Whether a kit window's own <form> survives inside DialogV2's form on Foundry 14. The callbacks of the describe window, the Autopsy window and Create a Key Remnant here read fields by name off d.element.querySelector('form') (observe.mjs:1267-1272 f.name.value; gm-items.mjs:1677-1681; key-remnants.mjs:1188-1197), which reaches them only if the body's <form> was dropped when the content was parsed into the dialog's form, as the harness models it (audit/harness/lib/shim.mjs:1740-1745). utils.mjs dialogContent:1030 hands DialogV2 a detached div, in which the inner <form> exists. The owner's table sessions used these windows, which argues that it works; the reading that settles it: on v14, open Observe's describe window and run document.querySelector('.dialog form form') in the console (null: dropped).

Whether a trace's open GM card loses a half-typed field: showRemnantCard writes body.innerHTML on every renderActorSheetV2 (remnant-ring.mjs:245), outside live.mjs's focus rule, so a re-render of the trace's sheet while a GM types would drop the text; and a card closed with Escape while a field holds focus may fire no blur, so nothing is saved (356-376). Which updates re-render a token actor's sheet on v14, and whether Escape blurs first, need a real Foundry: type in 'What analysis reveals', have a player find that trace (its token is un-hidden), read the field; then type and press Escape, reopen, read the field.

A Frisk ask withdrawn before its window has drawn: withdrawAsk (frisk.mjs:1104-1111) finds no dialog to close, and the render callback then starts the full clock (1142-1148), so the window would stand for up to 60 s with two buttons that send nothing (1154). The gap is the window's render time; no road that cancels an ask that fast was found. Not measured.

A co-owner's Frisk window closes with 'The request is withdrawn.' when the other owner answered (frisk.mjs:887 with 1110), also when that answer was 'Let them look'; the target's own card follows. Read, not judged a finding.

The surface list names 'a Remnant's card and its ring's menu': remnant-ring.mjs and remnants.mjs hold no menu (grep -i 'menu|contextmenu|hud' in both: 0 lines). The ring is drawn, not pressed; a double-click on the token opens the card through Foundry's own sheet.

scripts/truth-bullets.mjs draws no window and no button (grep for drpgWindow, <button, addEventListener, data-action: 0 lines); it holds the guard that puts a player's edit of a bullet back and tells the GMs (onBulletWrite:1518, revertPlayerBulletEdit:1404). The Truth Bullets' windows and the Present button are in sheet-inventory.mjs, trial.mjs and gm-items.mjs, read at the lines given; the row's Share (handover.mjs), the hub's Give tab and Take a Truth Bullet were not read.

Seen in passing in gm-items.mjs, outside this reader's files: Give a Truth Bullet with an empty name, and Issue the Autopsy with nobody ticked, close the window first and warn after (1507-1509 with 1571-1574; 1691-1695), so every other typed field is lost; the reshape windows were changed to open again for the same reason (cleanup-reshape.mjs:164-167). For the reader of gm-items.mjs.

Create a Key Remnant here (key-remnants.mjs:1116-1209) was read only as the handler of the Observe card's first button; with no room in its select its primary closes with nothing said (1206), which the domain reader's hints already carry.

The Present row's held look is repainted on updateSetting of the floor alone (sheet.mjs:79-81), the class controls-01-trial-console-4 found for the console's first write in a world; whether sync.mjs applyFor(trialQueue) redraws the sheet on that first write was not read. A press on a stale button is refused by the window with the same line (trial.mjs:181-186).

Called by the handlers and not read here: action-pipeline.mjs canAfford, rollTrait, abort; actions.mjs spendAction; price.mjs quotePrice, payPrice, refundPrice; gm-bridge.mjs callGm, claimCard, settleCall; trait-ruling.mjs traitFor; cleanup.mjs concealFromWitnesses and chargeTamper (1394-1538); bridge-guards.mjs sayNotDone. A refusal inside them is taken as told on their callers' word.

Read in part, by outline and grep for controls: frisk.mjs 1-380, 660-767, 927-1040 (the primary's judgement); remnants.mjs outside the lines listed (the ledger, the migration, placement); cleanup.mjs 800-1540 and 1720-2555 (the GM's resolution); remnant-ring.mjs 545-859 (the ring's drawing); truth-bullets.mjs 1-1290 and 1730-1985. None of those parts builds a window, a button or a listener on one (grep).
A player's Remnant card has no control; whether it follows the owner's copy of the bullets' refs while open is the live-refresh pass's (the domain reader's stale_windows hint).
